simple.meaning: הָלַם (hâlam) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to strike down; by implication, to hammer , stamp , conquer , disband.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 9 times across Judges, 1 Samuel, Psalms, Proverbs, Isaiah, beginning at Judges 5:22. Its contexts include righteousness.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to הָלַם (H1986).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: הָלַם (hâlam) / H1986 is traced through Judges 5:22, Judges 5:26, 1 Samuel 14:16, Psalms 74:6 as a generated source-based concept entry.

structuredEvidence.definition: to strike down; by implication, to hammer , stamp , conquer , disband

firstOccurrence.englishText: Then the horse hoofs stamped because of the prancing,

timeline.evidenceText: Then the horse hoofs stamped because of the prancing,
She put her hand to the tent peg,
The watchmen of Saul in Gibeah of Benjamin looked; and behold, the multitude melted away and scattered.
Now they break all its carved work down with hatchet and hammers.
Let the righteous strike me, it is kindness;
“They hit me, and I was not hurt!

For the fields of Heshbon languish with the vine of Sibmah. The lords of the nations have broken down its choice branches, which reached even to Jazer, which wandered into the wilderness. Its shoots were spread abroad. They passed over the sea.
Woe to the crown of pride of the drunkards of Ephraim, and to the fading flower of his glorious beauty, which is on the head of the fertile valley of those who are overcome with wine!
So the carpenter encourages the goldsmith.

definitions.usage: beat (down), break (down), overcome, smite (with the hammer).
definitions.full: H1986. halam [ הָלַם ] verb smite, hammer, strike down (compare Phoenician מהלם below below מַהֲלֻמוֺת ); — Qal Perfect 3feminine singular וְהָֽלְמָה consecutive Judg 5:26 ; 3 plural הָֽלְמוּ 5:22 ; Isa 16:8 ; suffix הֲלָמוּנִי Prov 23:25 ; Imperfect 3masculine singular suffix יֶהֶלְמֵנִי Psa 141:5 ; 3 masculine plural יַהֲלֹמ֑וּן 74:6 ; Participle active מָּ֑עַם ה֫וֺלָם Isa 41:7 (compare Ges § 29 , 3 b); passive construct הֲלוּמֵי 28:1 ; — smite (with hammer), followed by accusative of person Judg 5:26 (fatally; || מָחַץ מָחַק, ); also figurative of correction, discipline Psa 141:5 (|| הוֺכִּיחַ ); of intoxicating, wine שְׂרוּקֶּיהָ הָֽלְמוּ גוֺיִם בַּעֲלֵי שִׂבְמָה גֶּפֶן Isa 16:8 the vine of Sibma, its choice branches smote down lords of nations (so Hi De Che Brd Di and others, RVm; lords subject according to Ges Ew and others AV RV); also יַיִן הֲלוּמֵי smitten down by wine 28:1 ; compare further Prov 23:35 ; followed by accusative of thing ה֫וֺלָםמָּֿ֑עְם Isa 41:7 one striking an anvil; smite down , or strike off Psa 74:6 (object פִתּוּחִים carved work ); also absolute of horse' hoofs Judg 5:22 . — On וַהֲלֹם 1Sam 14:16 see הֲלֹם .
